metadata.question: Was the land surface temperature in New Mexico in July 2016 higher than in any other July over the past 30 years?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need land surface temperature (LST) data for New Mexico - Compare July 2016 to all other Julys in past 30 years (1987-2016) - MODIS Terra LST (MOD11A1) available from 2000, Landsat has thermal bands but less consistent - Use MODIS LST products: MOD11A1 (daily, 1km) from 2000-2016 gives us 17 years - For earlier data (1987-1999), would need Landsat but coverage is inconsistent - Given MODIS limitation, will analyze 2000-2016 period 2. Masking strategy: - MODIS LST has QA bands to filter poor quality pixels - Mask clouds and poor quality observations using QC_Day band - LST is in Kelvin * 0.02 scale factor 3. Logic: - Calculate mean LST for each July from 2000-2016 over New Mexico - Compare July 2016 to all other Julys - Valid Zero: LST values should be positive (in Kelvin, ~280-320K typical) - C3: If any July has None/null or unrealistic values (e.g., <200K or >400K) - A: If July 2016 is highest - B: If any other July is higher or equal ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define New Mexico geometry const newMexico = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/States') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'New Mexico')) .geometry(); // 2. Function to get mean LST for a specific July function getJulyLST(year) { const startDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 7, 1); const endDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 7, 31); const col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(newMexico) .select('LST_Day_1km'); return col; } // 3. Collect LST data for all Julys from 2000-2016 const years = []; const lstValues = []; for (let year = 2000; year <= 2016; year++) { const col = getJulyLST(year); const size = col.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) { console.log(`Year ${year}: No images`); console.log("C1"); return; } // Calculate mean LST (convert from Kelvin*0.02 to Celsius) const meanImg = col.mean(); const stats = meanImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: newMexico, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const lstKelvin = stats['LST_Day_1km_mean']; const count = stats['LST_Day_1km_count']; if (!count || count === 0) { console.log(`Year ${year}: No valid pixels`); console.log("C2"); return; } if (!lstKelvin || lstKelvin < 200 || lstKelvin > 400) { console.log(`Year ${year}: Invalid LST value`); console.log("C3"); return; } const lstCelsius = lstKelvin * 0.02 - 273.15; years.push(year); lstValues.push(lstCelsius); console.log(`${year}: ${lstCelsius.toFixed(2)}°C (${size} imgs, ${count.toFixed(0)} px)`); } // 4. Find the year with maximum LST const july2016LST = lstValues[lstValues.length - 1]; const maxLST = Math.max(...lstValues); const maxYear = years[lstValues.indexOf(maxLST)]; console.log(`\nJuly 2016: ${july2016LST.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Maximum: ${maxLST.toFixed(2)}°C in ${maxYear}`); // 5. Determine answer if (july2016LST === maxLST) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
